description:
## [1.6.14](https://github.com/hackingguy/morphe-patches/compare/v1.6.13...v1.6.14) (2026-07-06)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **mygate:** use robust Dialog.show methodCall filter for ShowUpgradeDialogFingerprint to bypass log stripping ([7c8f763](https://github.com/hackingguy/morphe-patches/commit/7c8f7637e7f3e2d11c9ff249154a36303751b755))

patches.name: Bypass license check
patches.description: Bypasses the Google Play LVL backend license check, allowing full app access without activation.

patches.name: Freedium
patches.description: Adds a profile setting to choose the Freedium Mirror host, and a floating button on articles that opens the current article using the chosen Freedium Mirror in a webview.

patches.name: Flutter Premium Bypass
patches.description: Forces premium status inside the JSON payload sent to Flutter

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Removes MyGate in-app ads (pre-approval screen, allow-entries screen, activity feed, and visitor profile masthead).

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Unlocks all MyGate premium features: spoofs USER_PREMIUM_PLAN status, suppresses upgrade dialogs and paywalls, enables frequent pre-approvals for deliveries, cabs and visiting help, unlocks surprise delivery and the always-approve-entries toggle.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Unlocks all AT4K premium features by forcing the premium status to true.

patches.name: Unlock Pro
patches.description: Spoofs Splitwise Pro subscription status everywhere it is checked — bypasses the server-driven feature gate (charts, receipt scanning, currency conversion, default splits, auto-split, transaction import, itemization), forces Person.isPro() to true for receipt quality and UI gating, and suppresses all in-app upsell ad banners (home-screen, recent activity, post-add-expense). Works entirely client-side with no server interaction.

patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Suppresses Truecaller's CleverTap behavioural event tracking to prevent user-activity telemetry.

patches.name: Enable premium features
patches.description: Unlocks all client-side premium features by bypassing the feature-availability gate.

patches.name: Hide 'Get Premium' banners
patches.description: Dismisses premium upgrade prompts and paywall screens automatically.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Removes ads from the after-call screen and caller-ID overlay.

patches.name: Hide premium upgrade prompts
patches.description: Removes 'Get Premium' and 'Switch to Premium' buttons from the nav bar, settings, and profile.

patches.name: Mock premium
patches.description: Always shows the premium/gold badge and unlocks premium UI features.

patches.name: Remove Premium UI
patches.description: Removes the Premium tab from the bottom navigation bar and the Premium row in the profile section.
